product.name: Ledger API

product.name: Ledger Schema and Ledger Designer
product.description: A declarative schema system and dashboard tool for designing, modeling, and managing ledger accounts and entries.

product.name: SDKs and CLI Tools
product.description: Software development kits and command-line interface tools for interacting with the Ledger API and managing ledger schemas and entries.

product.name: Data Export to AWS S3
product.description: A service to export ledger data to AWS S3 for analytics, compliance, and integration with third-party systems.
